about: Default email formats an organisation starts with (D-032, INT-14a). One per after-call action. The model or the agent writes only the body; opening and signature are static blocks merged verbatim, with {{placeholders}} filled from the call. Links (proposal, booking page) live in the static blocks so they are sent exactly as the admin wrote them; a [square-bracket] line is a link the admin still has to paste, and the app warns before sending it.

formats.name: Follow-up
formats.subject: Following up on our call
formats.body: Thank you for your time today. Here is a short recap of what we discussed and the next step we agreed on.

formats.name: Meeting confirmation
formats.subject: Confirming our next meeting
formats.body: This confirms our next meeting. Reply to this email if the time no longer works for you.

formats.name: Proposal
formats.subject: Your proposal from {{company.name}}
formats.body: As promised, here is the proposal we talked about. I am happy to walk you through it.

formats.name: Book a time
formats.subject: Pick a time that suits you
formats.body: Thank you for your time today. Choose a slot for our next conversation with the link below.
